body.statement: For arbitrary ordered absorbing support \(\mathcal S\) and positive law \(\Pi\), derive a necessary-and-sufficient rule, expressed only through adjacent adoption-mass ratios and ordered interval endpoints, for the sign and vanishing of every \(L_{j,t,\ell}(\Pi)\); in particular, characterize exactly when all off-diagonal causal-lag loadings vanish. The construction must cover repeated boundary cumulative coordinates and every nonsingular support-rank stratum.
body.justification: A closed sign law is the genuinely open structural content beyond computing the tensor at one supplied law.
body.gap: Sun and Abraham and Wright diagnose cross-horizon contamination from residualized event-time regressors, but no adjacent-mass sign frontier is available for reshaped finite-memory carryover coefficients.
body.consumer: The diagnostic would tell an OpenTable analyst which calendar cells can reverse a current or lag coefficient before outcomes are inspected.
